title: Deficiency Balance Accounts Closure Letters, Bureau Reporting and Agency Placement Schedule
content:
The closure, credit-reporting and agency-placement terms of Deficiency Balance Accounts are the same in every Deficiency Resolution Band.

| Term | Band 1 | Band 2 | Band 3 | Band 4 | Band 5 | Band 6 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Calendar days after the final payment within which the paid-in-full letter is mailed | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Calendar days after closure within which the bureaus are updated | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Calendar days without a posted, unreturned payment (counted from the later of the opening date and the latest such payment) after which an open account is referred to an outside collection agency | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 | 120 |
| Whether payments, plans and settlements on a referred account are handled only by the agency | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |

## Credit bureau status reported (all six bands)

| Event | Status reported |
|---|---|
| Balance paid in full | "paid in full, account closed" |
| Settlement | "account paid in full for less than the full balance" |
| Referral to a collection agency | "account transferred to collection agency" |

## Points of reading

- The referral count starts from whichever is later: the opening date or the date of the latest payment that was posted and not returned. A payment that is later returned does not restart the count.
- Hypothetically, an open account opened on a given day with no payment ever posted reaches the referral figure on the 120th calendar day after the opening date.
